people.role: Head of Nhạn Trận Môn since 1142; drills the plain's levies every spring and keeps the gate out of Lạc Hà's quarrels
people.appearance: A square, weathered man with a grey goose feather in his felt cap and a voice that carries the length of a lake shore without being raised.
people.backstory: Mục Hàn Nhạn was born in 900 in Nhạn Thanh Thành, the grandson of a levy farmer who walked out of Chiết Kích Nguyên in Thạch Liệt Hàng's file (N-nhan_tran-01). Fever took his parents when he was six, and the founder Thạch Liệt Hàng (thach_liet_hang) took him into the gate. He learned the file from Quản Tề Phong (quan_te_phong) and has been head since she died in her breakthrough in 1142. In the cold year of 1120 the archers of Nhạn Thanh Thành shot the geese from the walls (A171). He walked the walls breaking bows until the city forbade it, which is how the plain came to call him the Cold Goose. He drills the farmers of Thảo Đường and Nhạn Thanh on the shore of Lạc Nhạn Hồ every spring, and he has sent Lạc Hà's Geese Hall its best drill master's training, ten years of Thịnh Kinh Hàn (thinh_kinh_han). He calls Lạc Hà's war elder Cảnh Trường Thiên (canh_truong_thien), who drilled the first squads for nine years without pay, the gate's second founder.
people.wants: To keep Cảnh's word and the gate's files at home, and to make Lạc Hà pay at last for the file it lost on the bridge.
people.secret: Before he died in 1040 the founder told him why the gate swears never to break file. In the grey of 803 a young Kết Đan of the One Colour field ran past Thạch's line alone and empty-handed, and on his deathbed Thạch named him: Cảnh Trường Thiên. Mục kept it out of gratitude for the nine unpaid years until Kiều Thiết Dực's file died on the bridge in 1174. In 1175 he went to Cảnh and sold his silence for Cảnh's word that Lạc Hà will never again call or hire the gate's files for a war. Each spring since, Cảnh has flown down to drill the levy for nothing, and Mục bills the cities for a Lạc Hà war elder's drill and keeps the fee in the gate's chest.

people.appearance: A huge farmer-built man with a drumstick through his belt and a laugh like a buffalo.
people.backstory: A Thảo Đường farmer's son who came to the spring levy at sixteen and never went home. Quản Tề Phong (quan_te_phong) made him a disciple. He has drilled the plain's farmers on the lake shore for a century and believes a gate that drills for war and never goes is lying to them. He writes to Lạc Hà's Hình Trọng Sơn (hinh_trong_son), and the Watch's war party counts the gate's files as its army. He thinks the head a coward, and he has promised Hình the gate's second file, Cổ Thiết Liệt's (co_thiet_liet), on the day the pact is signed.

people.role: The head's daughter and true disciple; the point of the first file
people.appearance: A tall, rangy woman with her father's square jaw, a grey feather in her braid and a point-sword worn high on the back.
people.backstory: Mục Tân Vũ was born in 1140 in Nhạn Thanh Thành to the head Mục Hàn Nhạn (muc_han_nhan) and a Thảo Đường grain-merchant's daughter who never cultivated and died in 1190. She has held the point of the first file since 1180, the youngest in the Roll of Files. She drills by day and duels by night where the gate cannot see, because the gate forbids single fights. She has never been in a war. Her friend in Lạc Hà, Hình Lạc Nhạn (hinh_lac_nhan), walked three hundred paces into the miasma of Chiết Kích Nguyên in 1196 (N-lac_ha-07) and came back with a boy's shoe. The two of them have the same question: whether the founders really walked out of that grey in file, and whether a file could walk back in.
people.wants: To lead a file into something real, and to prove that the founders' art works by walking it into the grey.
people.secret: She has promised Hình Lạc Nhạn a file of ten to walk into the miasma with her, breathing in turns the way the founders did. For two years she has drilled the ten at night on Hắc Thứu Đài from Thạch Liệt Hàng's notes, which Lương Thủ Hàng (luong_thu_hang) took out of the Roll of Files for her. Đổng Kiên Lũy knows and has said nothing.

people.role: Keeper of the Roll of Files and the burial rows
people.appearance: A thin, bald man with a writing board on a cord round his neck and the names of the dead under his fingernails.
people.backstory: The great-grandson of a man in Thạch Liệt Hàng's file of forty (N-nhan_tran-01), born at the gate. He keeps the Roll of Files, which lists every disciple by the file they stood in and not by name, and the burial rows below the gate, where a gap is left in each row for the dead of 803 who were not brought off the plain. In 1198 he took the founder's notes out of the Roll for Mục Tân Vũ (muc_tan_vu) himself and told Mục Hàn Nhạn (muc_han_nhan) they were being rebound, because he wants the gaps in the burial rows filled.

people.appearance: A short, heavy man who walks with a stiff left leg and stands in file even when he is alone.
people.backstory: A rice farmer's son from Hòa Lũng Thôn and the only man of Kiều Thiết Dực's (kieu_thiet_duc) file to come home from the Ferry War. Lạc Hà hired the file to hold the near end of a rope bridge on the Ngư Ca border in 1174. Tùng Đào's raiders cut the ropes (A202) and the file went down with the bridge. He came up downstream with his leg broken in three places. He teaches the outer gate to stand, and he has never once said Tùng Đào's name aloud.

people.role: Founder of Nhạn Trận Môn (806); led a file of forty out of the grey at Chiết Kích Nguyên
people.backstory: A levy captain of Nhạn Thanh Thành and a Trúc Cơ of forty-three at Chiết Kích Nguyên (C017). When the grey rose his file of forty held its line, breathed through one wet cloth in turns and walked out backwards (N-nhan_tran-01). In 806 he founded the gate with the survivors (V096) and swore its disciples would never again fight in loose order. Lạc Hà's Cảnh Trường Thiên (canh_truong_thien) drilled them for nine years. He never said aloud whom he had seen run, except once, on his deathbed, to Mục Hàn Nhạn (muc_han_nhan).
